description: Send ChowDeck login SMS (validate phone → auth/login). Does not accept OTP. Ask the user for their phone first, then for the SMS code, then call verify_login_otp.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

step_2_body_phone.description: User-provided phone without country prefix (local NG format like 080…). Never invent or reuse another account's number.

name: request_login_otp
